Tamil Nadu CM's election and Karur stampede case face legal challenges

The Supreme Court and Madras High Court are handling multiple legal challenges concerning Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin's election victory and his government's actions following the Karur stampede. While the High Court admitted petitions challenging the CM's election, the Supreme Court declined a DMK plea to restrain the CM from commenting on the stampede, though it agreed to hear a separate plea related to the incident.
